replay: fresh replay after C47 producer-boundary edit
symptom: The deterministic semantic-response producer exited 1 because the live validation runner response omitted the Operation field.

evidence.producerCause: serializer exited 1 because the runner response was not in canonical schema (Operation missing)

rootCause: The requested operation is already authoritative at the main validation boundary, but the new semantic-response parser incorrectly required the model to repeat that mechanical operation field. The live runner returned the model-owned semantic fields without Operation, so the producer rejected before candidate publication.
correction: Move Operation ownership fully to the deterministic producer: parse only model-owned semantic fields, require the boundary operation to be VALIDATE_SLICE, and serialize the literal Operation field into the generated Runner response. Update the runner contracts to exclude Operation from the semantic payload.
whyCodeVsPrompt: The operation is supplied by the official launcher/preflight and is not a model decision. Requiring the model to copy it created a recurring mechanical format failure; the producer can serialize it deterministically before candidate validation without repairing a rejected artifact.
regression: Extend the semantic-response regression so canonical model-owned input without Operation produces Operation: VALIDATE_SLICE, while an explicit Operation field is rejected as producer-owned output.
